headline: Volume growth to outstrip the industry growth

highlights: Anand Rathi Research India Equities Manish Valecha Research Analyst Vibha Jain Research Associate Cement Result Update India I Equities 14 November 2026 Star Cement Volume growth to outstrip the industry growth; maintain BUY Star Cement’s quarterly performance was impacted owing to floods in assam along with elevated cost environment.
Further, volume growth would continue to outstrip the industry demand growth.
The company’s capacity expansion remains a key long-term growth driver, targeting ~18-20 MTPA by FY31 with peak net debt/EBITDA capped at 1.5-1.6x.
Thus, we maintain BUY rating on the stock with a revised TP of Rs223 (from Rs265 earlier), valuing it at 10x Sep-28e EV/EBITDA.
valuation: The company’s capacity expansion remains a key long-term growth driver, targeting ~18-20 MTPA by FY31 with peak net debt/EBITDA capped at 1.5-1.6x.
Thus, we maintain BUY rating on the stock with a revised TP of Rs223 (from Rs265 earlier), valuing it at 10x Sep-28e EV/EBITDA.
Expansion Updates: Targeting ~20m tonne cement capacity by FY31e (from current level of 9.7m tonne), the announced expansion will expand cement capacity to 18m tonne by FY29e.
watch: The company’s capacity expansion remains a key long-term growth driver, targeting ~18-20 MTPA by FY31 with peak net debt/EBITDA capped at 1.5-1.6x.

Floods and High Cost Impacted Performance: The company’s cement sales volume (including clinker~74k tonne) grew by just 2% y/y to 1.2m tonne in Q2FY27, as the demand was impacted mainly due to floods in its key operating region.
